title: Iron Legion AI profile
description: A battle-AI personality (content/ai/profiles/*.json5; Simulation Spec 13, 15.4, Modding SDK 4.8): the army-level tunables of SIM-AI-010..014, the cadences of SIM-AI-002 and the action sets it decides with. Factions name one in `ai_profile`; a scenario may override it per side. Every numeric field is required, like a rules file. The loader checks that `action_sets` names exactly one army set and one regiment set.

general_aggression.description: The bodyguard engages only while this exceeds the enemy's share of the strength ratio (SIM-AI-022).

reserve_fraction.description: Fraction of the infantry cost held in reserve (SIM-AI-014).

stance_margin.description: A new stance must beat the current stance's score by this much; retreat is exempt (plan decision 10).

army_period_ticks.description: Army decisions every this many ticks, staggered by side (SIM-AI-002).

regiment_period_ticks.description: Regiment decisions every this many ticks, staggered by regiment id (SIM-AI-002).

approach_distance.description: Where the attacking line forms before advancing (SIM-AI-011).

advance_step.description: How far the line anchor steps toward the enemy per army period once the line is formed (plan decision 22).

line_tolerance.description: Mean slot error under which the line counts as formed; also the slot error a regiment ignores.

skirmish_range_frac.description: Skirmishers stand ahead of the line until the enemy is within this fraction of their range (SIM-AI-011).

flank_offset.description: How far beyond the enemy's flank the cavalry groups aim (SIM-AI-011).

charge_trigger_dist.description: Main-line distance to the enemy at which the flank groups charge (SIM-AI-011).

standoff_max_ticks.description: The attacking line rests at approach_distance for at most this many ticks, whatever its missile units' ammo (SIM-AI-011, T3-010).

charge_max_fatigue.description: The line runs its charge only while its mean fatigue is under this; a more tired line walks in (SIM-AI-011, T3-010).

defend_search_radius.description: Radius around the centroid searched for the highest ground on defend (SIM-AI-012).

counter_charge_dist.description: An enemy this close to a line end draws the cavalry counter-charge (SIM-AI-012).

screen_offset.description: Where the cavalry screen holds on retreat, toward the enemy from the infantry (SIM-AI-013).

screen_gap.description: The screen withdraws once the infantry is this far away (SIM-AI-013).

reserve_offset.description: How far behind the line the reserves, the bodyguard and falling-back regiments stand (SIM-AI-014).

commit_morale.description: A line regiment below this morale draws a reserve (SIM-AI-014).

action_sets.description: One army set and one regiment set under content/ai/actions/, in any order.

campaign.description: Campaign personality (Phase 4; parsed and hashed now, unread until then).
